answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a bridge toll: every new identity must complete one verifiable, time-boxed task before crossing into paid work, so creating a thousand fake accounts costs a thousand real efforts. Rotating knoll sentinels, chosen at random each epoch and paid only when their reports prove true, watch the crossing and flag identical work patterns, while new entrants are grafted onto an orchard lineage by a sponsor. If a grafted identity is caught cheating, the sponsor loses standing and the whole branch is pruned, so Sybils cannot hide behind borrowed trust.
